youtubeDescription: Explore Aquacellum's breeder tools for professionals. From spawning dashboards to genetic insights, these features help breed and manage aquatics with precision. Available exclusively in the Pro mode.

beats.onScreen: Aquacellum Pro logo and a breeder dashboard overview.
beats.narration: Aquacellum Pro delivers a suite of tools for breeders. Manage specimens, track lineage, and predict genetics with precision.

beats.onScreen: Register screen: entering specimen details and minting a certificate.
beats.narration: Start with Register. This feature lets you mint a birth certificate for a specimen, recording its origin in your breeding records.

beats.onScreen: Lineage viewer: multi-generation pedigree tree with specimen details.
beats.narration: Use the Lineage viewer to explore a specimen's pedigree. See multi-generation trees and track ancestry without missing connections.

beats.onScreen: Spawning Wizard dashboard: pair selection, tank setup, genetic analysis.
beats.narration: Next is the Spawning Wizard. Pair breeders, assign tanks, and analyze genetic markers. Offspring are registered automatically.

beats.onScreen: Genetics screen: trait predictions and COI calculator with risk bands.
beats.narration: Genetics tools predict traits and measure inbreeding risk. The COI calculator highlights risks for first-cousin, half-sib, and full-sib pairings.

beats.onScreen: Grow-out funnel: eggs, fry, survival rates, and batch yield charts.
beats.narration: The grow-out panel tracks your yield. Measure survival rates, checkpoint history, and chart progress over time.

beats.onScreen: Morph submission screen: adding details for verification.
beats.narration: Submit new morphs for verification. Pending submissions are marked with an unread badge for easy tracking.

beats.onScreen: Sale demo: sealed pedigree document included in a listing.
beats.narration: Pedigree data travels with your listings. Each sale includes a sealed, tamper-evident document and its ancestor chain.

beats.onScreen: Breeder achievements screen: milestones and unlocked tracking rewards.
beats.narration: Achievements track your milestones as a breeder. Log progress and unlock rewards over time.

beats.onScreen: Closing screen: Aquacellum Pro logo, tagline, and call to action.
beats.narration: Aquacellum Pro is built for breeders. Unlock precision tools to manage your aquatics with care. Try it today.
